conclusion: Verified: The supplied MISEV2023 guidance (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) supports the high-level reviewer conclusions that orthogonal EV characterization, transparent production reporting, controls to distinguish EVs from non‑vesicular particles, and validated assays are required before attributing in‑vivo signals to intact EVs or advancing formulation/bridging claims. Not verified (unsupported) are any program‑specific assertions that SGL‑001 has already met those criteria or that rodent intranasal data alone predict intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species—because the guidance is not program data and does not include validated assay reports, manufacturing records, stability/potency comparability, or cross‑batch biodistribution data for SGL‑001.
unsupported_assertions: Program-specific documentation that SGL-001 source‑cell MCB/WCB have been generated and characterized is not provided in the supplied evidence.
Validated intact‑EV analytical method reports for SGL-001 (including LLOQ, specificity, precision, accuracy) are not present in the supplied evidence.
A validated, stability‑indicating potency assay for SGL-001 and demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Representative release, stability, and potency comparability data across 6 GMP‑like batches for SGL-001 are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Formulation/device compatibility recovery data (ex vivo and/or in vivo controls) for SGL-001 are not provided in the supplied evidence.
Empirical program data demonstrating that rodent intranasal biodistribution reliably predicts intact‑EV CNS exposure in larger species are not provided in the supplied evidence.
